scientific_integrity: The theorem uses a full analytic proof of convergence, center-manifold coefficients and a summable inverse-square expansion; finite arithmetic and numerical checks are supporting diagnostics only. The source is properly distinguished from the new higher-lag theorem.
scientific_limitations: The two-term inverse-square asymptotic applies to initially strictly positive histories in (0,1], not general sign-changing histories.
The result assumes fixed finite memory, nonnegative normalized weights and positive instantaneous and maximal-lag coefficients.
The theorem does not imply nonlinear chaos, cryptographic security or uniform estimates as memory length increases.
Equivalent unindexed results in parabolic finite-delay center-manifold literature remain a publication-priority risk.
title: A sharp five-lag threshold for the logarithmic clock of critical sine-memory dynamics
